Defects #141 and #142. The session row carries a three-valued status (active, ended, and an undocumented legacy NULL that still appears on new rows), and its aggregates such as span_count are only incremented at ingest while the trace view is merged at read time. Nothing can recompute the row from its spans or detect that the two disagree. Make the row derivable from spans, and give status one documented set of values.
